decisive_items: Intraretinal cystoid changes and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption in the right eye
central macular thickening in fundus examination
response.rationale: R5 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including both cystoid macular changes and macular thickening, which are indicative of traumatic maculopathy. R2 is the runner-up because it also has support from the vignette, including subtle irregularity of the outer retinal layers and further loss of outer retinal layers, but it does not capture the full range of macular changes described in the vignette.

too broad, only captures electrical injury without specifying ocular effects
too narrow, only captures posterior subcapsular cataract
